Ensure installation and correct use
Safety Instruction
Preface
 Thank you very much for choosing to purchase our printer .
 To ensure that you fully understand the performance of this product and its correct and safe use, please be sure to read this instruction manual thoroughly and keep it properly.
 The contents of this manual and product parameters are subject to change without prior notice. If you have any questions about the product, please consult relevant technical personnel.
 We have done our best to edit this description and test this product. If you find any errors, please let us know. We
would be very grateful.
 To ensure safe and correct use of this product, please read this manual carefully before use.
 Please keep it in a safe place and refer to it when necessary.
 Keep this product out of reach of children or non-professionals.
Explain usage conventions
 To ensure safe and   correct use   of this product   and prevent   personal injury   and property   damage,   make
sure   you   fully   understand   the   differences   between   the   following   categories   before   reading   the
instructions.
 Ignoring precautionary information such as WARNING may result in operator injury.
 such as CAUTION may result in operator injury or equipment damage.
Please read the following instructions before using this product.
Printer Installation Notes
WARNING
 Do not   install   or   use   the   product   near   volatile   solvents   (alcohol   or   thinners). Do not   place any   objects   on   top   of   this
product.
CAUTION
 Do not place this product in a tilted or vibrating place.

 Placing it this way may cause the device to tip over or be damaged.
Avoid using this product in the following places
 Excessively humid or dry places
 Direct sunlight
 High temperature places
 Near open flames or moisture
 The suitable environment for this product is: temperature 18  ℃ -30  ℃ , humidity 40 % -60%.
Power   supply   safety   precautions
WARNING
If the power cord is damaged, please disconnect the power cord as soon as possible and repair it yourself
 Be careful that electricity may leak from damaged areas, causing fire or short circuit.
 Do not use wet hands to switch the power on or off to avoid electric shock or short circuit.
Avoid using the same power outlet for multiple devices
 This may cause a short circuit or even a fire.
Do not bundle or wrap the power cord
 This may cause a short circuit or even a fire.
When installing the ground wire, special attention should be paid
 Suitable ground wire locations: power supply terminal and ground stake terminal
 It is prohibited to connect grounding wires to water pipes, gas pipes, telephone lines, lightning conductors, etc.
Operational   safety   precautions
WARNING
 Do not attempt to disassemble or repair the device yourself.
 If the device makes noise, produces smoke or flames, or emits unpleasant odors, etc., you must
immediately turn off the power and contact the manufacturer from which you purchased the device.
 Do not use flammable objects or products around the device.
 Before moving the device, you need to unplug it from the power source.
 When transporting the device, make sure the print head is in the home position.

Manual/Auto/Stop status: The main interface is mainly used to switch the working mode in manual or automatic mode, and open and close the winding, mesh belt, suction,

powder   shaking,   and   powder   sprinkling   functions.   After   switching   from   manual   to   automatic   mode,   all   functions   will   be   opened   by   default.   However,   because   some
functions are controlled by the film detection sensor in the automatic state, the winding, mesh belt, and powder shaking functions will be automatically closed and opened

Drying 1: Displays the set heating temperature and actual temperature of drying zone 1

Winding speed: The rotation speed of the film winding motor is 0%-100%. Set the motor rotation speed according to the actual situation. The default is 30%-60%.
Mesh belt speed: The rotation speed of the mesh belt motor is 0%-100%. Under normal circumstances, the speed is recommended to be 10% higher than the film speed.
Powder shaking speed: The rotation speed of the powder shaking motor is 0%-100%. The speed of the powder shaking motor is set according to the powder left on the film.

Powder   spreading   speed:   The   rotation   speed   of   the   powder   spreading   motor   is   0%-100%.   The   speed   of   powder   spreading   is   set   according   to   the   actual   situation   of
powdering. The default setting is 40%-60%.
Powder return: The switch function of the automatic powder return motor. After it is turned off, the automatic powder return will not work  automatically.
Mesh belt: forward and backward, control the forward and reverse rotation of the mesh belt. Default is forward

Powder   Sprinkling:   Forward   and   reverse,   control   the   counterclockwise   and   clockwise   rotation   of   the   powder   shaft,   mainly   used   to   solve   the   problem   of   the   motor   being
stuck due to foreign objects. The default is forward.
Temperature setting: used to adjust the temperature settings of the front guide plate, drying zone 1, drying zone 2, and drying   zone 3. The drying zone 1 is   not enabled for
the double-head machine.

Front   guide   plate:   Pre-drying   treatment   of   ink   before   powdering   to   reduce   the   moisture   in   the   ink.   The   recommended   temperature   for   two   heads   is   50 ℃ ,   the

recommended   temperature   for   four   heads   is   60 ℃ ,   and   the   recommended   temperature   for   six   heads   is   60-80 ℃ .   It   can   be   increased   or   decreased   according   to   actual
conditions.

Drying   zone   1:   Pre-drying   treatment   of   powdered   materials.   The   recommended   temperature   for   two   heads   is   60 ℃ ,   the   recommended   temperature   for   four   heads   is
70-80 ℃ , and the recommended temperature for six heads is 80-100 ℃ . The temperature can be increased or decreased according to actual conditions.

Drying   zone   2:   Pre-drying   treatment   of   powdered   materials.   The   recommended   temperature   for   two   heads   is   90 ℃ ,   the   recommended   temperature   for   four   heads   is
90-120 ℃ , and the recommended temperature for six heads is 120-140 ℃ . The temperature can be increased or decreased according to actual conditions.

Drying   zone   three:   pre-drying   treatment   of   powdered   materials.   The   recommended   temperature   for   two   heads   is   90 ℃ ,   the   recommended   temperature   for   four   heads   is
90-120 ℃ , and the recommended temperature for six heads is 120-140 ℃ . The temperature can be increased or decreased according to actual conditions. Information   interface:
